logical_column.persistent_physical_state: stored once in the state-handle registry as F-KT-owned committed state
logical_column.diagnostics: stored per column in the runtime diagnostics registry, separate from physical state
forbidden_per_column: F-KT reusable checkpoint as persistent column state

registries.states: one committed F-KT state carrier per active logical column
registries.forcing: referenced by handle and independently assignable per column
registries.diagnostics: runtime-owned accounting keyed by column id

composition_rule: A logical column is a tile/component. It is not defined as one MODFLOW cell.
